verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a single-call card creation endpoint, instant-issue virtual cards, and a self-serve public sandbox with interactive API widgets (marqeta-docs-1, marqeta-docs-12, marqeta-docs-37, marqeta-docs-3), supporting quick sandbox-to-live card flows. However, the pack never explicitly confirms the create-card response returns PAN/CVV/expiry directly (PCI widgets suggest secure display rather than raw API exposure) nor documents a self-serve path to production without a sales process. Missing for 10: explicit API response schema showing PAN/CVV/expiry fields, and evidence of self-serve production onboarding without a sales cycle.
